verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect many-item automation. SCIM-based automatic provisioning of users and groups into SaaS apps (docs-3, docs-4), and lifecycle workflows that run processes automatically against users (docs-5, docs-18), both act on many identities at once. Graph can list user objects (docs-11), but nothing documents an explicit bulk-operation capability such as bulk create/update/delete or batched API calls. Missing for 10: documented bulk import/update/delete of users or groups, a Graph batch request capability, an agent-friendly bulk workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
